title: PH60108: Mesoscopic Physics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Length scales characterizing mesoscopic systems, Quantum de-coherence and
entanglement, Quantum scattering, Landauer s Formula, fluctuations and
Aharanov-Bohm effect, ballistic electron transport, Coulomb blockade, quantum
wires and related phenomena, quantum dots and artificial atoms, anti-dot
lattices- classical and quantum chaos, electron-phonon interaction in
nanostructures, photonic crystals, quantum dot lasers. Thermodynamic and
transport properties in various regimes e.g. ballistic, diffusive and ergodic
and statistical modeling of their fluctuations.
